why: A case listed here is one the TypeScript SDK has no surface for. Each entry names the missing method, because 'unsupported' is a gap in the client, not a property of the spec — and an entry without a reason is indistinguishable from a case nobody bothered to map.

cases.timeseries.range_query: TimeSeriesModel.query() throws NucleusNotSupportedError — the TypeScript SDK has no raw point-range read at all. Python's client synthesises one by bucketing TS_RANGE_AVG over the range, so the op exists there and not here.
cases.timeseries.aggregate_over_a_bucket: TimeSeriesModel.aggregate() takes a NAMED interval (second/minute/hour/day/week/month), so the spec's 300000 ms window cannot be expressed. The TypeScript SDK does not carry the L1 bug — it converts its names to bucket_millis itself and never calls TIME_BUCKET — but it also cannot request an arbitrary bucket width.
